# Molecular report: completeness checklist

> Adapted from clinical lab practice for this research exercise.

## Patient and sample
- [ ] De-identified patient ID
- [ ] Specimen type and biopsy site
- [ ] Tumour content (and whether it is enough for reliable variant calling)
- [ ] Clinical indication / recorded cancer type

## Test information
- [ ] Method: whole-genome (DNA) and RNA-seq, tumour/normal paired
- [ ] Genome build (hg19 here) and transcript set (Ensembl v69 here)
- [ ] Variant QC thresholds (VAF ≥ 5%, ≥ 3 alt reads)
- [ ] Limitations: somatic only (no germline), no fusions or structural variants in the public data, copy number not included

## Results
- [ ] Each variant in HGVS nomenclature (p. and c.) with gene and transcript
- [ ] Variant allele frequency
- [ ] Classification (oncogenic / likely oncogenic / VUS) and AMP/ASCO/CAP tier
- [ ] Evidence sources cited for each reported variant
- [ ] Overall interpretation, including whether the genetics support the recorded tumour type

## Recommendations
- [ ] Suggested follow-up (e.g., germline testing, fusion panel, IHC)
- [ ] Caveats on interpretation

## Sign-off
- [ ] Curator and date
- [ ] Second review
